lessons.text: Interval/timing ACs need a bounded-count (or fake-clock) assertion; a lower-bound-only count passes under a busy loop and discriminates nothing.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a test fixture s stub returns the same value the un implemented path would produce e g an immediate retry policy answering time now the assertion cannot tell consulted from ignored give at least one test a distinctive value
lessons.text: When a test fixture's stub returns the same value the un-implemented path would produce (e.g. an immediate-retry policy answering time.Now()), the assertion cannot tell 'consulted' from 'ignored' — give at least one test a distinctive value.
